name: What is the difference between repairing an automatic gate and a manual gate?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing an automatic gate and a manual gate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing an automatic gate typically involves addressing issues with its electrical components, motor, sensors, and remote control systems, in addition to any mechanical wear. Manual gate repair primarily focuses on mechanical components like hinges, latches, posts, and structural integrity. Automatic gates often require specialized diagnostic tools due to their complex electrical systems, whereas manual gate repairs are generally more straightforward and involve less specialized expertise. We service both types of gates in our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Automatic gate repair involves electrical and mechanical components, while manual gate repair focuses on mechanical parts, with automatic gates requiring more specialized tools.
